**Given:**

Following observation table is given along with frequency.

Median = 28.5

**Formula used:**

To calculate median we always need to calculate the cumulative frequency.

So, when discrete date is given then we find the cumulative frequency just greater than (N/2) 

Where N = Total frequency 

Median = l₁ + [ N/2 - c.f.over f ]× h

Where l₁ = lower limit of the median class 

f = frequency of the median class 

h= size of the median class 

c = cumulative frequency of the class preceding the median class
